string.text: Gravity altered the course of the stars, pulling me here. Tololo, reporting in.
Alright, time to start today's work.
What's they shiny thing in your hair, Tololo?
This hair accessory was a gift from Leader Qiongjiu. The shimmering moonstone gleams softly, carrying the color of the sky.
Tololo, let us head out on patrol.
Okay Tololo, that's enough. Please head back to base.
This way, there will be time to do what I love, right?
